subject: Validation needed: Nimble Solutions repeated workspace top-ups
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Unusual promo/top-up pattern detected — Nimble Solutions (nimble-123)

Logan,

Security flagged a pattern that looks like repeated promotional top-ups across multiple workspaces tied to Nimble Solutions (org id: nimble-123). We saw 5 distinct workspaces request trial/top-up credits over the last 48 hours; activity sample attached. The accounts are low-usage but each requests immediate full promo balance and then switches API keys.

Initial observations: 
- Multiple email domains (nimble.solutions and nimble-team.com) but same billing address on some requests.
- Rapid creation of workspaces, identical IP fingerprinting for signup flows (see csv).
- No previous enterprise billing history in our backend.

Attachments: nimble_activity_sample.csv (CSV of account ids, timestamps, IP hash)

Recommend: pause automatic promo grants for any new Nimble workspaces, ask sales/CS to validate identity before approving credits, and collect one-off org proof (W-9/incorporation + PO) if they want additional credits.

I can run a deeper audit if you want me to pull full request headers.

-neha
Neha Kapoor
Security Analyst, Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unusual promo/top-up pattern detected — Nimble Solutions (nimble-123)

Thanks Neha — copying Marissa (AM) and Ben (CS) to own outreach. Suggested customer response below; please tailor.

Marissa / Ben — can you reach out to Nimble and request the following before any additional promo/top-ups are granted: 
1) Proof of organization (W-9 or articles of incorporation)
2) A single billing contact and purchase order if this is procurement-led
3) Clarify why there are multiple workspaces and which team owns billing

If they can share the docs, we can consider a one-time, limited top-up while Neha keeps monitoring. If they cannot, please pause credits and flag for fraud hold.

Suggested one-line outreach (feel free to send):
Hi Alex — we saw multiple top-up requests from Nimble-related workspaces in the last 48 hours. To proceed with any additional credits we need a billing contact and either a W-9 or PO. Can you share that so we can expedite?

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nimble.solutions>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Validation needed: Nimble Solutions repeated workspace top-ups

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the note — we hit some urgent capacity limits for a cross-team hire event and multiple engineers asked for quick credits while we stood up ephemeral projects. Sorry for the noise.

I can provide our incorporation docs and a PO. Attaching a PO request now — internal procurement is slow but I can push. For speed, would a W-9+PO suffice? We have separate sandbox workspaces per team but billing should route to a central procurement process.

Can you bump up the promo to the requested $2k across the primary workspace while we get the PO signed? That would keep the demos running.

Alex Rivera
Head of Platform Engineering
Nimble Solutions
alex.rivera@nimble.solutions

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 11:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Validation needed: Nimble Solutions repeated workspace top-ups

On Thu, Feb 11, 2027 at 8:21 AM Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nimble.solutions> wrote:
> Hi Logan,
>
> Thanks for the note — we hit some urgent capacity limits ...

I received the W-9 and a draft PO from Alex (attached). W-9 looks valid and the billing address matches the account on file. They also included a short note from procurement saying they expect a full PO by EOD next week.

Attachments: nimble_w9.pdf, nimble_po_2027Q1.pdf

Recommendation: Approve a one-time $2,000 promotional top-up on the main workspace (nimble-primary) only, and block auto-credits for any other workspaces tied to nimble-123. Put a 30-day watch and require a PO/invoice before any subsequent credits. I think that balances risk and momentum for the deal.

If security approves (Neha), I'll send the credits and update HubSpot.

-Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Feb 2027 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Validation needed: Nimble Solutions repeated workspace top-ups

Thanks all for the triage. I reviewed the W-9 and the activity sample. A couple quick notes: 

- W-9 is fine for tax/identity; the draft PO helps but is not definitive evidence of procurement control.
- Pattern of multiple sandbox workspaces spinning up and requesting credits raises abuse risk; the IP fingerprint data Neha flagged is concerning.

Decision: we can approve a single, one-time $1,000 goodwill credit to nimble-primary to keep the trial/demo moving, not the full $2k. Condition: credits are limited to that workspace id, expire in 30 days, and future credit requests are denied until a signed PO or invoice is on file. Security to continue monitoring; if any anomalous usage or more workspaces ask for credits, we freeze account and escalate.

Logan/Marissa — please communicate this to Alex and ask procurement to upload the signed PO to the HubSpot company record link below before any further disbursements.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/nimble-docs

-priyom
Priyom Das
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
